phases.title: Architecture Pivot & Source Authority
phases.goal: Establish one canonical V3 source, preserve safety invariants, and freeze legacy Three-Lane as rollback-only.

phases.title: Single-Lane Deterministic Core
phases.goal: Extract a one-project/one-task durable runtime while preserving exact-once and Brain planning semantics.

phases.title: ChatGPT Browser Event Bridge
phases.goal: Make ChatGPT the center with two warm tabs and event-driven detection/action instead of polling as the normal path.

phases.title: Recovery & Resilience
phases.goal: Recover transient ChatGPT/browser failures with bounded retry/reload/reconnect while preserving exact-once state.

phases.title: Latency & Observability
phases.goal: Measure and reduce Robot overhead while keeping correctness and privacy-safe diagnostics.

phases.title: Plus-Only AI Integration Boundary
phases.goal: Keep OpenAI API cost at zero while exposing a transport-neutral local interface that can support future MCP without dependency.

phases.title: Legacy Cleanup & Migration
phases.goal: Remove multi-lane machinery from the V3 path, migrate state safely, and retain an isolated rollback entry point until cutover.

phases.title: Qualification & Owner Cutover
phases.goal: Qualify the locked candidate through smoke, continuous, fault-injection and overnight soak before Owner-authorized deployment.

invariant_evidence.rule: Owner STOP/AUTOSTART_DISABLED blocks startup, recovery and automation; only explicit Owner START may clear the latches.

evidence.proof: STOP or AUTOSTART_DISABLED => blocked; OWNER_STOP returned before recovery
launch exits and loop is gated while STOP or AUTOSTART_DISABLED exists

invariant_evidence.rule: Exactly one roadmap task is active; Work stops after evidence; Brain verifies before ACCEPT/REJECT and NEXT PLAN.

evidence.proof: one directive/task stop boundary plus PLAN→DISPATCH→VERIFY→ACCEPT/REJECT→NEXT PLAN
narrow fail-closed directive and correlated previous-result schema

invariant_evidence.rule: dispatch_id and relay_id remain stable across retry/reconciliation; stale or mismatched identities fail closed; relay confirmation is not semantic ACCEPT.

evidence.proof: dispatchId derived from lane_id|task_id|directive identity digest; persisted latch identity is verified before reuse
relay_id, response_digest and text_digest bind retries and marker confirmation
Brain verdict requires task_id plus relay_id correlation

invariant_evidence.rule: Work result relay authority is text-only; screenshots/files are not transport authority.

evidence.proof: persists relay identity/digests then sends relay.text through Brain composer
removes legacy screenshot_path while preserving relay identity/retry state

invariant_evidence.rule: Persist durable identity/intent before dispatch, relay or watchdog actions whose replay could duplicate or become ambiguous.

evidence.proof: PERSISTED_NOT_SENT latch atomically written before Work send
relay latch and attempt state atomically written before Brain send
watchdog Continue intent atomically written before ACTIONS.CONTINUE execution

invariant_evidence.rule: Actions bind to exact Brain/Work target identity; deterministic unavailable targets quarantine; recovery is finite and cannot reload storm.

evidence.proof: SHA-256 target identity plus deterministic missing/access-denied/stable-redirect classification
exact target descriptor is mandatory
reloadBudgetPerEpoch=1 and continueBudgetPerEpoch=1 with cooldown

invariant_evidence.rule: Auth/MFA/CAPTCHA/security/destructive/admin/ambiguous states stop automation rather than bypass controls.

evidence.proof: AUTH_REQUIRED, MFA_REQUIRED, CAPTCHA, DESTRUCTIVE_ACTION, ADMIN_ESCALATION and AMBIGUOUS_DECISION are hard-stop observations
securityBlocked returns BLOCKED_SECURITY

invariant_evidence.rule: Git/source evidence and persistent diagnostics contain sanitized IDs/digests/reason metadata only; no credentials, tokens/cookies, full private conversation URLs or chat bodies.

evidence.proof: explicit allowlist excludes message body, raw target URL, cookies and tokens
event schema uses correlation metadata including target_digest rather than raw private target data
explicit privacy prohibition is V3 authority

invariant_evidence.rule: Live process/browser/CDP truth outranks persisted recovery state; persisted state is recovery-only.

evidence.proof: truth_order is PROCESS_TRUTH then LANE_TRUTH then PERSISTED_RECOVERY_STATE; persisted_state_role=RECOVERY_ONLY; process_truth_required=true
health derives from authoritative wrapper child, dedicated Chrome and CDP process truth

invariant_evidence.rule: Merge, deploy, hotpatch and production cutover require separate explicit Owner instruction.

evidence.proof: production remains unchanged until Owner cutover; merge/deploy/hotpatch is Owner-explicit only
canonical V3 authority does not grant autonomous merge/deploy

rollback_must_not: reset task/latches/targets/profile as a side effect of rollback
replay an irreversible or replay-sensitive browser effect before durable-intent reconciliation
promote legacy Three-Lane/RBT planning back to forward source authority
